annotation_policy: Frozen engineering relevance cases, not expert gold labels, a representative user study, or exhaustive relevance annotations. Source definitions were reviewed before measuring these queries. Dev cases may guide implementation. Heldout cases must not guide tuning. Previously used exact search names occur only in dev.
baseline_input_policy: The current UI sends at most the first 300 characters of a task. Keep both full task and actual baseline query.

metrics.single: Fraction of positive single cases with an expected concept in top 5.
metrics.compound: Mean fraction of expected concepts found in top 10, across positive compound cases.
metrics.negative: Fraction of negative cases violating expect_empty or returning a forbidden concept in top 10. This is negative retrieval leakage, not evidence of inferred skill ownership.
metrics.limits: No precision metric because annotations do not enumerate every relevant result.
